quality_note: NISAR data are provisional. Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team.
method_note: Headline value = most negative median of ~1 km blocks (13x13 px, >= 50 % valid pixels, within-block std <= 2 cm) of the cumulative LOS map. Rate = linear extrapolation of 120 days (2026-06-21 to 2026-10-19, summer season) to one year: an ESTIMATE that likely overstates the annual net rate because part of summer subsidence recovers in winter. Vertical value assumes purely vertical motion (LOS / cos(incidence)). range_cm = spread of the headline value when the whole chain is re-referenced to up to two other stable windows >= 30 km away.
confidence_note: Low confidence: P107 F070 swath edge leaves >50% of the ±0.25 deg box uncovered (valid_fraction=0.267 < 0.40), 1 pair was dropped in QC (30.1% affected), plane-only deramp without DEM leaves steep Alborz mountain-front topographic/unwrapping artifact at 54.3954E, 36.5926N (-34.6 cm), and reference sensitivity spread is 60.1% (range_cm=[-34.6, -13.8]). Do not use as a headline basin rate.
